== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Galactic Union]] is the largest interplanetary government within civilized space, centered around the human birthplace at the heart of the galaxy. Its territory includes human space, the [[Dornoth system]], and the [[Aethril]], though its influence extends even further. The Union maintains a vast communication network known as the [[Subline]] and utilizes specialized military forces, including power-armored soldiers. While some view it as a potential force for good that could unify the galaxy, others see it as an entity driven by a desire for galactic dominance. The government has been involved in a devastating civil war and faces ongoing conflict with the [[Iron Legion]], an enemy it has fought for centuries. Beneath its official structure, the Union is reportedly manipulated by a [[Shadow|shadow]] organization called [[Solstice]]. This group is believed to operate from the [[Fathom system]], which serves as the Union's headquarters. There are allegations that [[Solstice]] engineers galactic chaos to justify Union intervention and peacekeeping efforts. The Union's leadership includes President [[Telappen Vashei]], a human woman described as stern yet kind. Despite its scale, the Union faces challenges from splinter factions that fled during its takeover and must navigate complex relationships with other powers like the [[Karoshan Alliance]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Union functions as a military and political entity that includes the [[Aethril]]. This organization serves as a source from which ships can be borrowed, and it has even granted [[Varic Vallenar|Professor Vallenar]] permission to remain at the [[Magic Tower]]. Furthermore, the Union is a territory that can be traveled deeper into.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Union is a long-standing entity that has been engaged in warfare against the [[Iron Legion]] for centuries. While [[Solstice]] maintains influence over everyone within the organization, the group contains various insurrectionist elements and has been linked to the destruction of the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]]. The Union's actions have led to [[Mariala Brechess|Mariala]] and her fellow students becoming fugitives, and its ships have been observed firing upon [[The Last Horizon]]. Furthermore, the entity's connection to [[Karosha]] has become a subject of scrutiny.}}
